title: Spicy Italian Pasta with Almond Crust
description: A spicy and savory pasta dish with a crunchy almond crust.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add red pepper flakes and cook for an additional minute.
Add tomato sauce and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer.
In a separate pan, toast slivered almonds over medium heat until fragrant.
In a small bowl, mix together Parmesan cheese and chopped basil.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, tomato sauce mixture, and Parmesan cheese mixture. Toss to combine.
Transfer pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with toasted almonds.
Bake in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
